entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/ad
entities.reasoning: Deployment creates pods that were throttled >90% CPU, triggering RequestErrorRate and RequestLatency alerts.
entities.evidence: CPUThrottlingHigh alert on pod ad-554b849958-wpj2l with throttle_pct 91.7%; RequestErrorRate and RequestLatency alerts fire after 17:43.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/ad
entities.reasoning: Service downstream of the throttled pods, observed increased error rate and latency.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate and RequestLatency alerts include ad service traffic; NoRequestsDetected snapshot at 17:52 shows missing responses.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend depends on ad service; experienced errors due to ad failures.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate alert spans all services and peaks after ad throttling; frontend logs show 5xx responses (inferred from alerts).

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/checkout
entities.reasoning: Checkout orchestrates order processing and suffered latency spikes from upstream ad errors.
entities.evidence: RequestLatency alert active for entire stack after 17:50, coinciding with ad throttling period.

propagations.condition: Pods throttled >90% CPU causing high error responses
propagations.effect: Service ad returns errors and high latency

propagations.condition: Frontend calls ad for ads during page load
propagations.effect: Frontend returns 5xx errors, contributing to overall error rate

propagations.condition: Checkout queries ad for promotional content
propagations.effect: Checkout latency increases, observed in RequestLatency alert

alerts_explained.explanation: Pods in otel-demo namespace exceed CPU throttling threshold, indicating resource contention.
Overall request error rate exceeds threshold across services, driven by ad service failures.
Request latency across services exceeds threshold, downstream of ad throttling.
Snapshot shows no successful requests during peak, confirming outage.
Informational alert about alert inhibition; not directly related to failure.
